I tried to get a free vacation at a presentation in Vegas and I told them I was single and had no savings and could not afford the $1000 downpayment and they didn't care. if I sat through the presentation I could receive a 2night voucher to Wyndham Las Vegas. comments.text: Just be straight up when you go to the presentation.  They say 90 minutes -say you’re leaving after 90 minutes and time it.  Then when that’s up - say you’re leaving.  Keep saying no.  Walk away with your various prizes.  We’ve had excursions, cash, vouchers, everything.  And we always walked away after 90 minutes. Just remind them of the huge timeshare after market.  I prefer to be straight up and say ok I’ll attend but I’m not buying anything.  They will insist and say okkkkk… then try and keep you until you get exhausted and agree.  Say no.  It feels so good.  One time I had to tell a man, you’d have an easier time squeezing blood from a stone than getting a penny out of me.  Another time I told someone that I wouldn’t take a depreciating asset if someone gave it to me free.  They’d have to pay me monthly for me to take that on.  And one time, a salesman asked me “why do you think so many people are buying”.  And I told him “the bible says a fool and his money are easily parted!”  His face contorted and he ran to get his slick “boss”, the closer.
